verdicts.evidence: The card on the right has only the "Your name" and "Home landing" fields above Sign up, and the note below says "We send one short note when the timetable changes"; there is no email or phone field.

The rounded bar on the water at the right of the figure is the same saturated blue as the Sign up button and has rounded corners; it is shorter than the button (about 24px against 44px), but the likeness the finding describes is real.
"Home landing" is an empty free-text input with no dropdown arrow or list of options.
